The filer's member, and the comparative column of the same filing, give the full name 'Petco Health & Wellness Co, Inc.', and that is what we publish. Par, cost and value tie to the printed line. Publishing the cut-off text would make the name worse, and no printed form of the full name spells 'and' the way the rule needs, so no fix applies. Every other flagged row of this finding (the members shifted one line in the 10-Q) is fixed by context-keyed row corrections in sandbox bcpf.
